name: chakra-control-balance
intent: Dual inputs drive a needle into a ±0.08 centre band; hold 380ms to lock balanced control.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Resolved Chakra Control Balance state immediately

acceptance: Needle must stay inside ±band 0.08 for lockHoldMs 380 to reach LOCKED
Wobble uses halfLifeMs 90 before settling; lock pulse is lockPulseMs 150 one-shot
Leaving the band before lock cancels the hold timer
Reduced motion jumps needle to centred LOCKED immediately
